channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: London’s National Gallery to cut staff as it faces £8.2m deficit
item.description: The institution is offering a “voluntary exit scheme” for all employees and will be reducing its activities

item.title: Club for working-class art professionals expands from London to northern England
item.description: Working Arts Club founder Meg Molloy says its growth is necessary since "class issues in the art world are systemic, not geographic”

item.title: ‘He is a hero to me’: artist speaks out after Ukrainian athlete barred from Winter Olympics for commemorative helmet
item.description: Iryna Prots, who created the imagery on Vladyslav Heraskevych’s helmet—which honours Ukraine’s war dead—says she feels the decision to disqualify him violates the Olympic spirit

item.title: The US struggles with history, Stephen Friedman Gallery closes, Tudor Heart pendant acquired by the British Museum—podcast
item.description: Ben Luke speaks to our editor-in-chief, Americas, Ben Sutton about the disputes that have arisen as the US marks its 250 years since the Declaration of Independence—and hears about the demise of Stephen Friedman’s Gallery. Plus, the story of a heart-shaped pendant tied to Katherine of Aragon and Henry VIII

item.title: Tracey Emin: ‘I’ve done more in my last five years than in the whole rest of my life’
item.description: Tate Modern is hosting the largest retrospective to date of one of the UK’s biggest artists, who has never shrunk away from laying bare the most intimate and even traumatic details of her personal life

item.title: Museum dedicated to the Romantic movement reopens in Paris on Valentine’s Day
item.description: Former home of painter Ary Scheffer celebrates the Romantic period through art, music and soundscapes

item.title: The Big Review | Monuments, The Geffen Contemporary at Moca and The Brick, Los Angeles ★★★★★
item.description: By not going down more obvious routes, the exhibition, which places nine Confederate monuments in dialogue with 19 artists, avoids preachiness

item.title: See you, Searle: Guardian chief art critic bows out after 30 years
item.description: Adrian Searle has described writing for the paper as “an exhilarating ride”

item.title: Epstein files reveal Leon Black as a key collector of Van Gogh works
item.description: The New York collector Black is revealed to have bought five of the artist’s pieces

item.title: Museo de Arte Moderno de Bogotá dismisses longtime artistic director
item.description: The Italian curator and critic Eugenio Viola, who has led the museum since 2019, says he was let go after raising concerns about working conditions at the institution
